baseline_folder: the folder that holds this bundle, or -BaselineDirectory
selection: the newest bundle of this collector whose boot source recorded phase baseline, whose capture started before this run, and whose boot time was observed; newer baselines without an observed boot time (the game guard stopped them, or the read failed) are passed over and named
refuse_when: a listed baseline artifact is missing or its SHA-256 differs from the baseline manifest
this read has no observed boot time
the boot times differ (a reboot between the reads)
the baseline or this read has no observed process list
arithmetic: decimal subtraction of the cumulative counts; a negative difference is gap 6, never a delta

gap_codes.1: exited or not seen after; final count unavailable
gap_codes.2: process id reused or restarted; instances cannot be subtracted
gap_codes.3: new or not seen before; earlier count unavailable
gap_codes.5: identity missing or ambiguous process id; no delta
